answer_2.quote: The most commonly used evaluation metric for EAE, Exact Span Match (ESM)... We introduce BEMEAE... We also assess cosine similarity, BERTScore, and GPT-4 as automatic semantic matchers.

answer_3.quote: We utilized GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini (OpenAI, 2023)... evaluating a logistic regression classifier on cosine similarity... We evaluated  between the automated methods and human judgments under two settings...
methods: semantic matching with expert instructions and reference included

answer_4.quote: We sampled 500 candidate arguments... each candidate argument was reviewed by two human annotators... They were provided with the relevant document and asked to answer three specific questions... The inter-annotator reliability, measured by Cohen's kappa (κ), was 0.84 for RAMS and 0.95 for GENEVA.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered three questions: (1) validity check, (2) similarity check, (3) relationship determination.
criteria: Relationship (Conveys needed info, Entirely different but correct, Removes important details, Adds spurious content)
